annotation.title_clean: 15 CFR Part 744—Control Policy: End-User and End-Use Based
annotation.title_en: 15 CFR Part 744—Control Policy: End-User and End-Use Based
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bureau of Industry and Security, U.S. Department of Commerce
annotation.summary_en: US Export Administration Regulations Part 744 setting end-use and end-user based export controls: nuclear, missile/UAV, chemical-biological, military and military-intelligence end uses, advanced semiconductor and supercomputer uses, the Entity List, Unverified List, MEU List and SDN-linked restrictions. Only tangentially relevant to embodied AI via UAV and military controls.
key_provisions_or_claims: License required for items known to be used in nuclear, missile/UAV (300 km+), chemical or biological weapons activities
Restricts US persons' support for WMD, military-intelligence and advanced-node IC production
Entity List, Unverified List and MEU List impose license requirements, with 50 percent ownership affiliates rule
Military end-use/user controls for China, Russia, Belarus, Burma, Cambodia, Nicaragua, Venezuela
